title: 第9章 成长第10章 互相信任的第一步
content_zh:
这里一年四季温暖如春夏，他们又都小有实力，生活几乎没有压力！
利不爱说话但是为了让自己不用服兵役牺牲最大，米拉怕米莉天天欺负自己让自己自卑，每次吵架都是教育米莉！
上辈子也没有感受到这么直接的爱，想到这里瞬间李立峰眼泪掉了下来，找了个椅子坐了下来，看着通知，这一瞬间他想了很多！
这该死的服兵役，这该死的异族！
真是统统都该死！
“啊！
！”
想到气处吉恩不由得吼了出来！
这一声怒吼是声嘶力竭！
小树林里是惊鸟四起。
吼完后吉恩又感觉到深深空虚感觉找不到人生的意义所在了，又缩坐在椅子上！
我该怎么办？将这个星球给毁灭？找到温顿泽大陆所在的星球毁灭那个星球？然后呢？远走他乡？寻找下一个有智慧生命存在的星球？他感觉自己就像是一个漂浮在冰冷真空中星球，与其他星球都有着一条永远不会靠近的鸿沟！
你想要靠近它，它又会把你推开拉开！
许久
对了我还有米莉！
我还有米莉啊！
“哈哈哈！”
吉恩状若癫狂，想到这里突然跌跌倒倒的奔向学院大门口，不过等他跑到大门口时候人已经安静了下来。
这时候ai才找到机会给他分析了一通，ai的意思是这样正好，离开这个悲伤的地方去一个新的地方重新开始！
吉恩没有答话。

因为他也知道，这不失为一个不是方法的方法。
吉恩想到的是我可以把她送到飞船上去休养，米莉还需要我！
想到这里李立峰又稳稳了身形，他感觉身体里又有了力量，吉恩又转身先去学校教导处把通知给管理员看，然后再去将自己的东西收拾一下，就去和月夜恩娜安妮道别，这个世界很大，这一别可能这辈子都见不到面了，想想月夜的温柔恩娜的火辣安妮的聪慧，当然了三女表示等毕业了肯定去季风镇找吉恩，其实大家心里都知道正常来说怕是很难了！
挥手跟眼睛红了的三女告别后，吉恩就坐车去了领主府，顺利的见到了领主海姆.斯凯格丝伯爵，将事情说清楚后并把通知交给海姆伯爵，海姆伯爵表示自己没有问题，请吉恩男爵放心，一定会办妥，船今天晚上就会停在码头上（刚刚好昆特家族的船只今天路过斯凯格丝海港，因为这次刚好需要在这里补给物资），只要他去了就会有人带他上船，不过伯爵并没有催吉恩，可能他也觉得不好意思欺负一个小孩子！
吉恩礼貌的谢过了海姆伯爵，然后转身出府海姆伯爵还是派了马车将吉恩送到了家门口，到了家门口才发现门口停着一辆马车，周围还站九个守卫男女都有，个个气势不凡。
马车不小米莉应该就在马车上！
吉恩想过去看被守卫拦住了，吉恩马上表示自己是吉恩.苏，再者他也是身穿法袍，魔法师本身就带着权威，哪怕他胸前只有一颗星星！
（就是魔法师学徒的徽章）拉开侧门看见安静躺在里面的米莉，米莉一动不动的躺在马车里的木床上，除了呼吸正常外脸上没有一点血色，盖着被子现在也不好看她的状态。
“米莉放心你还有我。
我会照顾你这辈子的！”
说完拍了拍床边的被子，转身下了马车，打开院子的大门。
因为院子太小的原因马车是进不来的，吉恩问清楚些守卫的来意，才知道原来这些守卫都是利.苏在温顿泽大陆的手下，也是苏家族的骑士及骑士侍从。
因为他们都是利.苏封的骑士所以只要苏这个贵族家族没有倒，或者解除封号，再者与他们解除效忠合作契约，他们才能自由，要不然他们的利益就是跟苏这个姓氏绑定到一块的！
（除非他们想当逃兵！
或者隐姓埋名离开格林帝国或者天启大陆！
content_en:
It is as warm as spring and summer here all year round, and they are all very capable, so their lives are almost stress-free!
Lee doesn't like to talk much, but he sacrifices the most to save himself from military service. Mira is afraid that Millie will bully her every day and make her feel inferior. Every time she quarrels, she teaches Millie!
He had never felt such direct love in his previous life. Li Lifeng burst into tears when he thought of this. He found a chair and sat down, looking at the notification. He thought a lot at this moment!
This damn military service, this damn alien race!
Everything really deserves to die!
"Ah!
! "
Gene couldn't help but roared when he thought of his anger!
This roar was hoarse!
There were frightened birds everywhere in the grove.
After he finished yelling, Gene felt deeply empty and couldn't find the meaning of life, so he sat down in the chair again!
what do I do? Destroy this planet? Find the planet where the Winton Ze continent is located and destroy that planet? Then what? Moving away from home? Looking for the next planet with intelligent life? He felt like a planet floating in an icy vacuum, with a gap between him and other planets that would never come close!
If you want to get close to it, it will push you away!
a long time
By the way, I also have Millie!
I also have Millie!
"Hahaha!"
Gene looked like he was going crazy. Thinking of this, he suddenly stumbled and ran towards the gate of the college. However, by the time he ran to the gate, the people had already calmed down.
Only then did AI find the opportunity to analyze it for him. AI meant that it was just right, leave this sad place and start over in a new place!
Gene didn't answer.
Because he also knows that this is a method that is not a method.
What Gene thought was that I could send her to the spaceship to recuperate, and Milly still needs me!
Thinking of this, Li Lifeng stabilized his figure again. He felt that there was strength in his body again. Jean turned around and went to the school's teaching office to show the notice to the administrator. Then he went to pack his things and said goodbye to Enna and Annie on the moon. The world is a big place, and this farewell may never be seen again in this life. Thinking about the gentleness of the moon on the night, and the hotness of Annie's intelligence, of course the three girls said that they would definitely go to Monsoon Town to find Jean after graduation. In fact, everyone knew that it would be difficult to do it normally!
After waving goodbye to the three girls with red eyes, Jean took a car to the lord's mansion and successfully met the lord, Count Heim Skeggs. After explaining the matter clearly, he handed the notice to Count Heim. Count Heim said that he had no problem. Please rest assured, Baron Jean, it will be done. The ship will be done today. He would park at the dock at night (it happened that the Quint family ship passed by Skaggs Harbor today, because it happened to be a need to replenish supplies here). As long as he went there, someone would take him on board. However, the Earl did not rush Jean. Maybe he also felt embarrassed to bully a child!
Jean politely thanked Count Heim, then turned around and left the house. Count Heim sent a carriage to deliver Jean to the door of his house. When he arrived at the door of his house, he found a carriage parked at the door, and there were nine guards, both men and women, standing around. They were all impressive.
The carriage is not Xiao Millie should be on the carriage!
Jean wanted to go and see but was stopped by the guard. Jean immediately said that he was Jean Sue. Moreover, he was also wearing a robe. The magician himself carried authority, even if he only had a star on his chest!
(It's the badge of the magician's apprentice.) He opened the side door and saw Milly lying quietly inside. Milly was lying motionless on the wooden bed in the carriage. There was no color on her face except for breathing normally. She was not in a good state even though she was covered with a quilt.
“Milly, don’t worry, you still have me.
I will take care of you for the rest of your life! "
After speaking, he patted the quilt beside the bed, turned around, got out of the carriage, and opened the gate to the yard.
Because the yard was too small, the carriage could not come in. After asking the guards about their purpose, Jean found out thatThese guards are all Li Su's men in Wendenze Continent, and they are also the knights and knight attendants of the Su family.
Because they are all knights of Li Su Feng, as long as the noble family Su does not fall, or the title is lifted, or the allegiance and cooperation contract is canceled with them, they can be free, otherwise their interests will be tied to the surname Su!
(Unless they want to be deserters!
Or leave the Green Empire or Apocalypse Continent anonymously!
